blogs.title: Bye‑Bye Tokenizers: The Rise of Byte‑Level Large Language Models
blogs.description: An introductory post that explains why traditional tokenizers are a bottleneck for modern LLMs, outlines their limitations (bias, multilingual inequity, noise sensitivity), and introduces the Byte Latent Transformer (BLT) as the first tokenizer‑free architecture that matches token‑based performance at scale.

blogs.title: From Bytes to Patches: How Dynamic Entropy‑Based Patching Works
blogs.description: A deep dive into BLT’s core innovation—grouping raw bytes into variable‑size patches using next‑byte entropy. The article walks readers through static strided patching, whitespace patching, and the new entropy patching method, illustrating how patches allocate compute where it’s needed most.

blogs.title: Scaling Efficiently: Flop‑Controlled Training and Inference with BLT
blogs.description: Explains the concept of flop‑controlled scaling, how BLT achieves parity with Llama 3 while using up to 50 % fewer inference FLOPs, and why simultaneously growing patch size and model size opens a new scaling dimension for LLMs.

blogs.title: Robust by Design: BLT’s Superiority on Noisy Text and Low‑Resource Languages
blogs.description: Shows how training directly on bytes gives BLT enhanced robustness to character‑level noise, better orthographic and phonological understanding, and superior performance on long‑tail languages compared to token‐based models.

blogs.title: Inside the Byte Latent Transformer: Architecture Made Simple
blogs.description: Breaks down BLT’s three‑block architecture—local byte encoders/decoders and the global latent transformer—illustrating how cross‑attention pools byte information into patches and why lightweight local models save compute.

blogs.title: Byte‑ifying Existing LLMs: From Llama 3 to BLT in One Step
blogs.description: Describes the practical workflow of converting a pre‑trained tokenizer model into a BLT model by initializing the global transformer from Llama 3, fine‑tuning with lower learning rates for local modules, and the resulting performance gains.

blogs.title: Future Horizons: What Comes Next for Tokenizer‑Free Language Modeling?
blogs.description: Explores open research directions highlighted by the BLT paper—end‑to‑end learnable patching, scaling laws tailored for byte models, optimizing wall‑clock efficiency, and potential impacts on multimodal AI and on‑device inference.
